Name: Glass Milk Bottles for Content Patcher
Author: andiluxe
Description:
Not that there's anything wrong with ConcernedApe's original milk jugs, but wouldn't glass bottles feel more authentic? I thought so too, so here they are.  Note that this only replaces the images, all the other functionality remains the same.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/2494/2494-1531335246-527766536.png[/img]﻿[/center]

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1][*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/list]
